summary: Boone County, WV tower on Williams Hill: a telephone line ran from it by October 1926; registered with the FFLOS in 2008 as removed; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: FFLOS and the Forest Fire Lookout Association WV list say the tower was removed; no removal date found

events.note: A telephone line ran from the Williams Hill tower to Seth, Boone County; reported in a Charleston Gazette item of October 1926 quoted by Forest Lookouts
Registered September 16, 2008 as US 169, WV 19; nominated by Henry Isenberg

evidence.supports: administered by the West Virginia Division of Forestry
1926 telephone line from the tower to Seth, Boone County, then the Charleston long distance office
evidence.quote: From the Williams Hill tower there is a telephone line to Seth, Boone County, from which point messages can be transmitted through the Charleston long distance office.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts page marks the tower removed
West Virginia list marks Williams Hill as gone
evidence.quote: Williams Hill Boone 38.02512 -81.67799 Tower Gone FFLOS US 169, WV 19

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no build date, design, height or staffing found in the sources read. The 1926 item is cited through the Forest Lookouts transcription; the Charleston Gazette itself was not read. Worth a newspaper search or state survey before expanding; the story says nothing on current condition beyond what the sources give.
